garden:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Production background artwork for MemoryGarden, an interactive 2D personal memory garden web app. Create ONLY the garden environment, not a website screenshot or mockup.
Primary request: A beautiful cozy hand-painted botanical storybook garden, mature and quietly magical for young adults. Slightly elevated three-quarter view into a small sunlit clearing. Landscape 3:2 composition.
Scene: a softly winding stepping-stone path enters from the lower middle and curves toward an understated old wooden picket fence at the back. Natural beds of soft mossy grass and low leafy plants flank the pathway. Delicate tiny wildflowers grow only at the outer edges. Keep the central and lower-middle garden beds open, spacious and visually quiet so separate interactive memory flowers can later be placed there. About ten natural unoccupied planting areas, but no circles, grids, markers, spots, labels or UI.
Style: lovingly hand-painted gouache and watercolor children's storybook illustration with organic brush texture, refined botanical details, soft painterly edges, warm pastel light, natural muted sage/olive greens and warm cream highlights. Sophisticated and serene, not juvenile or cartoonish, not photorealistic, not pixel art, not 3D, not flat vector art. Consistent upper-left golden late-afternoon light and delicate grounded shadows. Restrained atmospheric depth, intimate scale, inviting.
Composition: garden fills the artwork, no oversized sky, enough quiet lighter space at upper left for a small live HTML logo and near upper center for a short live title. Distinct foreground grass detail at outer lower corners, not obstructing the central beds. The mobile version will reframe the same scene, so maintain a coherent central clearing.
Constraints: no people, no faces, no animals, no butterflies baked in, no sunflower or large flowering plants in the open memory beds, no pots in the central garden, no text, no lettering, no signage, no logos, no watermarks, no borders or UI. Opaque complete background. Create polished custom illustration worth pausing to look at, with gentle natural warmth and no harsh saturated colors.
sunflower:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: ONE isolated production sunflower sprite for MemoryGarden, matching the provided garden reference.
Input image: style and lighting reference ONLY. Do not reproduce its scenery.
Primary request: A single elegant, hand-painted sunflower plant with a warm muted golden bloom, detailed soft brown seed center, graceful sage-green stem, and three or four gently shaped botanical leaves. Full plant, from soil-level stem base to tallest petal, on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. No pot, soil mound, roots, garden, backdrop, ground plane or cast-shadow rectangle.
Style/medium: match the garden's warm refined watercolor/gouache storybook botanical illustration, natural softly textured brushwork, soft edges with clean readable silhouette. Mature and cozy, not childish, no face, not photorealistic, not plastic or 3D, not flat vector.
Lighting: soft golden sunlight from upper left, same muted organic greens and honey yellow as the reference.
Composition: portrait 3:4 source canvas, plant centered with its bottom stem anchored at x=50%, y=94%, entirely visible with transparent breathing room around all edges. Flower head near upper third, facing the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle; stem mostly upright, leaves spread organically. Flower head width approximately 45% of canvas, whole plant occupies about 85% height. Avoid big tilt or sprawling horizontal growth. It will be rendered at 120–200 CSS px tall on the garden.
Constraints: one sunflower only; no other plants or flowers; no lettering, watermark, border, fake transparency checkerboard, opaque background, scenery or props. Preserve a natural slim stem base so the sprite can stand precisely on a common soil anchor. No large detached shadow. Beautiful high-quality botanical illustration rather than a generic icon.
